\section[o século]{o século — a century}

\label{lesson:PT-C129-seculo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for the weekend, then the Portuguese for a date.

From a century down to an hour: say \emph{a hora}, with its silent h.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: o século}
\textbf{o século} — \textquotedblleft{}a century\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{século} $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{saeculum}, \textquotedblleft{}an age, a generation\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB 2.1) — a learned borrowing from Latin.
\end{cousinweb}
